description: This file defines the main activity class for the Android application using Jetpack Compose. It sets up the UI content by invoking the NiaCatalog composable and configures window behavior.

classes.name: NiaCatalogActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the app, extending ComponentActivity and setting the composable UI content.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the onCreate method to initialize the activity, set window fitting options, and define the UI content.
